sections.title: 3. Caching Opportunities
4. Memory Leaks
5. Redundant Computations
Priority Summary
sections.content:
| # | Issue | File | Impact | Effort |
|---|-------|------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Unbounded simulation cache | `simulation-agent.ts:320` | High (OOM risk) | Low — swap to `LRUCache` |
| 2 | N+1 post iteration in report | `analytics.ts:generateCampaignReport` | Medium | Low — single-pass groupBy |
| 3 | O(n²) includes in hashtag filter | `hashtag-analyzer.ts:recommendHashtags` | Medium | Low — Set conversion |
| 4 | Redundant analytics array passes | `analytics.ts:analyzePlatform` | Medium | Low — merge into one loop |
| 5 | Static hashtag scores recomputed | `hashtag-analyzer.ts:recommendHashtags` | Medium | Low — module-level memoize |
| 6 | No type index in VectorStore | `memory-agent.ts:VectorStore` | Medium | Medium — add secondary index |
| 7 | O(n) TTL cleanup scan | `memory-agent.ts:cleanup` | Low-Medium | Medium — sorted expiry queue |
| 8 | BFS paths not memoized | `causal-graph-builder-agent.ts` | Low | Low — keyed cache + invalidate |
| 9 | Pre-allocate simulation array | `simulation-agent.ts:runIterations` | Low | Trivial |

Items 1–5 are high-value, low-effort and should be addressed first.
